name: Day 2 — 一天的時間 Times of Day

readings.title: 起床太晚了 Waking Up Late

qs.q: What was the problem this morning?

gram.d: 太 + adjective + 了 = 'too …': 太晚了 too late, 太貴了 too expensive. The 了 is part of the pattern, not past tense.

qs.q: How late does he sleep on Saturday?
What does he do Saturday afternoon?
Why does he sleep early Sunday night?

gram.d: 跟 [person] 一起 [verb] = do something together with someone: 跟朋友一起去夜市. 一起 goes right before the verb.

readings.title: 忙的一天 A Busy Day

qs.q: What did he do in the afternoon?
When did he get off work?

gram.d: Time expressions come BEFORE the verb, never after: 我九點開會 (I meet at nine) — never 我開會九點. Same for 早上/中午/晚上.

qs.q: Why does he want a new computer?

gram.d: 有一點(有點) + adj = 'a little (too)…', slightly negative: 有一點貴 a bit pricey. Different from adj + 一點 (comparative): 便宜一點 = a bit cheaper.

readings.title: 跟同事吃午餐 Lunch with a Coworker (stretch)

qs.q: What did Xiao Chen recommend adding?
When did they return to work?

gram.d: 每 'every' pairs with 都: 每天都要排隊 — every day (without exception) you must queue. Chinese wants both words; dropping 都 sounds off.

dict.en: What time did you get up today?

dict.zh: 我們中午一起吃午餐吧！
dict.py: Wǒmen zhōngwǔ yìqǐ chī wǔcān ba!
dict.en: Let's have lunch together at noon!
What do you want to do this weekend?

dict.py: Wǒ qī diǎn xiàbān, hǎo lèi o.
dict.en: I got off at seven — so tired.

dict.py: Zhè tái diànnǎo tài guì le!

pass.zh: 我平常早上六點半起床，七點吃早餐，八點上班。中午休息一個小時。晚上六點下班，有時候跟同事一起去吃晚餐。

qs.q: What time does he usually get up?
How long is his lunch break?
What does he sometimes do after work?

scenarios.who: 同事小陳 Coworker Xiao Chen
scenarios.intro: Xiao Chen wants to grab lunch. Tell the time, agree on a plan, and set a meeting point — all with yesterday's and today's words.

them.zh: 欸 Eric，現在幾點？
them.py: Éi Eric, xiànzài jǐ diǎn?
them.en: Hey Eric, what time is it?

turns.task: Tell him it's 11:30.

ans.zh: 現在十一點半。
ans.py: Xiànzài shíyī diǎn bàn.

them.zh: 我好餓喔！中午要不要一起吃午餐？
them.py: Wǒ hǎo è o! Zhōngwǔ yào bú yào yìqǐ chī wǔcān?
them.en: I'm starving! Want to get lunch together?

turns.task: Say sure! Ask what time you'll go.

ans.zh: 好啊！我們幾點去？
ans.py: Hǎo a! Wǒmen jǐ diǎn qù?
ans.en: Sure! What time are we going?

them.zh: 十二點好嗎？公司附近有一家麵店很好吃。
them.py: Shí'èr diǎn hǎo ma? Gōngsī fùjìn yǒu yì jiā miàndiàn hěn hǎochī.
them.en: Twelve okay? There's a great noodle place near the office.

turns.task: Say okay, twelve o'clock, no problem!

ans.zh: 好，十二點，沒問題！
ans.py: Hǎo, shí'èr diǎn, méi wèntí!
ans.en: Okay, twelve — no problem!

them.zh: 那家店人很多，我們要早一點去排隊喔。
them.py: Nà jiā diàn rén hěnduō, wǒmen yào zǎo yìdiǎn qù páiduì o.
them.en: It gets crowded — we should go early to queue.

turns.task: Say okay — you'll come find him at 11:50.

ans.zh: 好，十一點五十分我去找你。
ans.py: Hǎo, shíyī diǎn wǔshí fēn wǒ qù zhǎo nǐ.
ans.en: Okay, I'll come find you at 11:50.

them.zh: 讚啦！等一下見！
them.py: Zàn la! Děng yíxià jiàn!
them.en: Sweet! See you in a bit!

turns.task: Say see you in a bit!

ans.zh: 等一下見！
ans.py: Děng yíxià jiàn!
ans.en: See you soon!

scenarios.intro: Xiaomei asks about your weekend. Make a night market plan: day, time, meeting spot.

them.zh: Eric！這個週末你想做什麼？
them.py: Eric! Zhège zhōumò nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?
them.en: Eric! What do you want to do this weekend?

turns.task: Say you don't know yet — maybe rest at home.

ans.zh: 我還不知道，可能在家休息。
ans.py: Wǒ hái bù zhīdào, kěnéng zài jiā xiūxí.
ans.en: Not sure yet — probably rest at home.

them.zh: 別在家啦！我們一起去夜市，好不好？
them.py: Bié zài jiā la! Wǒmen yìqǐ qù yèshì, hǎo bù hǎo?
them.en: Don't stay home! Let's hit the night market, yeah?

turns.task: Say sure! You really like night market food.

ans.zh: 好啊！我很喜歡吃夜市的東西。
ans.py: Hǎo a! Wǒ hěn xǐhuān chī yèshì de dōngxi.
ans.en: Sure! I love night market food.

them.zh: 那星期六晚上七點，捷運站見？
them.py: Nà xīngqí liù wǎnshàng qī diǎn, jiéyùn zhàn jiàn?
them.en: Saturday 7 p.m. at the MRT station then?

turns.task: Confirm: Saturday 7 p.m., MRT station, see you there.

ans.zh: 好，星期六晚上七點，捷運站見！
ans.py: Hǎo, xīngqí liù wǎnshàng qī diǎn, jiéyùn zhàn jiàn!
ans.en: Okay — Saturday 7 p.m., see you at the MRT station!

them.zh: 要不要也叫小陳一起來？
them.py: Yào bú yào yě jiào Xiǎo Chén yìqǐ lái?
them.en: Should we invite Xiao Chen too?

turns.task: Say sure — going together is more fun.

ans.zh: 好啊，大家一起去更好玩！
ans.py: Hǎo a, dàjiā yìqǐ qù gèng hǎowán!
ans.en: Sure — the more the merrier!

them.zh: 就醬，星期六見！
them.py: Jiù jiàng, xīngqí liù jiàn!
them.en: That's settled — see you Saturday!

turns.task: See you Saturday — bye-bye!

ans.zh: 星期六見，掰掰！
ans.py: Xīngqí liù jiàn, bāibāi!
ans.en: See you Saturday, bye!

scenarios.intro: Your phone rings — a colleague with a schedule change. Handle a basic call: answer, confirm you can talk, take the new time.

them.zh: 喂，你好，我是小陳。
them.py: Wéi, nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Xiǎo Chén.
them.en: Hello, this is Xiao Chen.

turns.task: Answer: hello, this is Eric.

ans.zh: 喂，你好，我是 Eric。
ans.py: Wéi, nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Eric.
ans.en: Hello, this is Eric.

them.zh: 不好意思，你現在方便說話嗎？
them.py: Bù hǎo yìsi, nǐ xiànzài fāngbiàn shuōhuà ma?
them.en: Sorry — is now a good time to talk?

turns.task: Say it's fine, no problem — what's up?

ans.zh: 方便，沒問題。有什麼事嗎？
ans.py: Fāngbiàn, méi wèntí. Yǒu shénme shì ma?
ans.en: It's fine, no problem. What's up?

them.zh: 明天的會議改到下午三點，你可以嗎？
them.py: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi dào xiàwǔ sān diǎn, nǐ kěyǐ ma?
them.en: Tomorrow's meeting moved to 3 p.m. — does that work?

turns.task: Say yes, 3 p.m. is no problem.

ans.zh: 可以，下午三點沒問題。
ans.py: Kěyǐ, xiàwǔ sān diǎn méi wèntí.
ans.en: Yes, 3 p.m. works fine.

them.zh: 太好了。資料我等一下寄給你。
them.py: Tài hǎo le. Zīliào wǒ děng yíxià jì gěi nǐ.
them.en: Great. I'll send you the materials shortly.

turns.task: Say thanks — you'll take a look in a bit.

ans.zh: 好，謝謝，我等一下看。
ans.py: Hǎo, xièxie, wǒ děng yíxià kàn.
ans.en: Okay, thanks — I'll look at them in a bit.

them.zh: 就這樣，明天見！
them.py: Jiù zhèyàng, míngtiān jiàn!
them.en: That's all — see you tomorrow!

turns.task: Say okay, see you tomorrow!

ans.zh: 好，明天見！
ans.py: Hǎo, míngtiān jiàn!
ans.en: Okay, see you tomorrow!

scenarios.who: 光華商場店員 Guanghua Market Clerk
scenarios.intro: Taipei's Guanghua electronics market. Buy a work laptop: ask price, push for something cheaper, pay by card.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！想看什麼？
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín! Xiǎng kàn shénme?
them.en: Welcome! What are you looking for?

turns.task: Say you want to buy a laptop (筆電 bǐdiàn) for work.

ans.zh: 你好，我想買一台工作用的筆電。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì tái gōngzuò yòng de bǐdiàn.
ans.en: Hi, I'd like a laptop for work.

them.zh: 這台很多人買，速度快，也不會太重。
them.py: Zhè tái hěnduō rén mǎi, sùdù kuài, yě bú huì tài zhòng.
them.en: This one's popular — fast, and not too heavy.

turns.task: Ask how much it is.

ans.zh: 這台多少錢？
ans.py: Zhè tái duōshǎo qián?
ans.en: How much is this one?

them.zh: 三萬二。現在打九折，兩萬八千八。
them.py: Sān wàn èr. Xiànzài dǎ jiǔ zhé, liǎng wàn bāqiān bā.
them.en: 32,000. With 10% off right now: 28,800.

turns.task: Say it's still a bit expensive — is there a cheaper one?

ans.zh: 還是有一點貴。有沒有便宜一點的？
ans.py: Háishì yǒu yìdiǎn guì. Yǒu méiyǒu piányí yìdiǎn de?
ans.en: Still a bit pricey. Anything cheaper?

them.zh: 這台兩萬三，也很不錯喔。
them.py: Zhè tái liǎng wàn sān, yě hěn búcuò o.
them.en: This one's 23,000 — also very solid.

turns.task: Say okay, you'll take this one — can you pay by card?

ans.zh: 好，我要這台。可以刷卡嗎？
ans.py: Hǎo, wǒ yào zhè tái. Kěyǐ shuākǎ ma?
ans.en: Okay, I'll take this one. Can I pay by card?

them.zh: 可以！發票幫您印出來。
them.py: Kěyǐ! Fāpiào bāng nín yìn chūlái.
them.en: Sure! I'll print your receipt.

turns.task: Say thanks — 辛苦了!

ans.zh: 謝謝，辛苦了！
ans.py: Xièxie, xīnkǔ le!
ans.en: Thanks — appreciate it!

scenarios.intro: You walked in late. Apologize simply, explain (traffic), and pivot smoothly to being ready for the 10 a.m. meeting.

them.zh: Eric，早。今天怎麼比較晚？
them.py: Eric, zǎo. Jīntiān zěnme bǐjiào wǎn?
them.en: Morning, Eric. Running late today?

turns.task: Apologize: you're late — traffic jam, and the MRT was packed.

ans.zh: 不好意思，我遲到了。今天塞車，捷運人也很多。
ans.py: Bù hǎo yìsi, wǒ chídào le. Jīntiān sāichē, jiéyùn rén yě hěnduō.
ans.en: Sorry I'm late — traffic, and the MRT was packed.

them.zh: 沒關係，路上小心就好。
them.py: Méi guānxi, lùshàng xiǎoxīn jiù hǎo.
them.en: It's fine — just be safe out there.

turns.task: Thank them; say you'll leave home earlier tomorrow.

ans.zh: 謝謝主管，明天我會早一點出門。
ans.py: Xièxie zhǔguǎn, míngtiān wǒ huì zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén.
ans.en: Thanks — I'll head out earlier tomorrow.

them.zh: 對了，十點的會議你準備好了嗎？
them.py: Duìle, shí diǎn de huìyì nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
them.en: By the way — ready for the ten o'clock meeting?

turns.task: Say yes, all prepared — you'll email the materials to everyone now.

ans.zh: 準備好了，資料我現在寄給大家。
ans.py: Zhǔnbèi hǎo le, zīliào wǒ xiànzài jì gěi dàjiā.
ans.en: All set — I'll email the materials to everyone now.

them.zh: 很好。會議之後跟我說一下進度。
them.py: Hěn hǎo. Huìyì zhīhòu gēn wǒ shuō yíxià jìndù.
them.en: Good. Brief me on progress after the meeting.

turns.task: Say no problem — you'll report progress after the meeting.

ans.zh: 沒問題，開完會我跟您報告進度。
ans.py: Méi wèntí, kāi wán huì wǒ gēn nín bàogào jìndù.
ans.en: No problem — I'll report progress after the meeting.

them.zh: 辛苦了，去忙吧。
them.py: Xīnkǔ le, qù máng ba.
them.en: Good work — go get to it.

turns.task: Say okay, thank you!

ans.zh: 好的，謝謝主管！
ans.py: Hǎo de, xièxie zhǔguǎn!
ans.en: Will do — thank you!

x: I drink coffee in the morning.
What do you want for dinner tonight?
We're going to the night market this weekend.
vocab.n: Taiwan writes 週末; simplified is 周末 — same word.

vocab.e: to go to work; be at work

x: What time do you get off?
vocab.n: 下班後 xiàbān hòu = after work — key social phrase.

x: Wǒ zuótiān shí'èr diǎn cái shuìjiào.
I didn't sleep until midnight yesterday.
Wǒ měitiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng.
I get up at 6:30 every day.
Zài wǔ fēnzhōng jiù hǎo le.
Zuò gāotiě yào liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
Tài guì le, wǒ bù mǎi.

vocab.n: 快 + verb = hurry up and…: 快來！Come quick!
Laptop = 筆電 bǐdiàn (short for 筆記型電腦).

slang.e: um, hello?? (what are you even doing)
x: 還沒開會你就要下班？是在哈囉？
Hái méi kāihuì nǐ jiù yào xiàbān? Shì zài hāluō?
Leaving before the meeting? Um, hello??
slang.n: Taiwan Gen-Z sass — literally 'are you hello-ing'. Playful exasperation, friends only.

x: Zhè jiā de niúròumiàn hěn kěyǐ!
slang.n: Taiwan youth-speak thumbs-up. Understated but enthusiastic.

x: We won the tender? Let's go!!
slang.n: Hokkien 媠 'beautiful' — the victory shout you'll hear at ballgames and offices alike.
Taiwanese Hokkien greeting; 呷飽沒 'eaten yet?' is the classic follow-up. Older folks light up when foreigners use these.

slang.e: to 'lie flat' — opt out of the rat race
x: 加班太累了，我只想躺平。
Jiābān tài lèi le, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tǎngpíng.
Overtime's killing me — I just want to lie flat.
slang.n: Mainland youth slang that crossed the strait; universally understood by young Taiwanese now.

x: 這個產業越來越內捲了。
This industry keeps getting more cutthroat for nothing.
slang.n: From mainland internet (simplified: 内卷); Taiwan media writes 內捲. Pairs with 躺平 as its cause.
Mainland internet acronym yyds, now pan-Chinese youth vocabulary. Use it about food for guaranteed laughs.
